name: Social Cover & Creator Post Image Prompts
body: # Social posts, covers, and creator content Ten Qwen Image 3.0 prompt recipes. Replace bracketed inputs before generation. All quoted text is exact; no translation is implied unless explicitly requested. Outputs require human review. ## SOC-01 — Balcony growing tutorial cover ```text Create a 3:4 social cover for a beginner balcony-growing guide. Show three small terracotta pots on a narrow shelf, each with a distinct leafy herb, and a compact watering can beneath. Use bright natural photography and a warm cream background. Render "A small balcony, a fresh start", "Three pots to begin", and "1/5" with the title occupying the upper third. No yield, health or guaranteed-growth claims. Keep pots grounded and railing geometry coherent. Variables: approved herbs and title. ``` ## SOC-02 — Triptych craft announcement ```text Create one 3:1 master image intended to be split into three square social posts. Show a long worktable with clay tools on the left, a ceramic pitcher in the center and folded linen on the right. Keep each square independently balanced; place "Make", "Share", and "Meet" in separate panels. Use consistent warm lighting and quiet cream margins. No essential object or letter may cross a crop boundary. This is a visual master, not three exported files. Variables: craft objects and three approved words. ``` ## SOC-03 — Research finding card ```text Create a 16:9 professional social card using [VERIFIED FINDING, DATA AND SOURCE]. Put one precise finding at the top, a simple supporting chart in the center and the source at the bottom. Use charcoal text and one teal accent on white. Preserve units, dates, sample limitations and uncertainty. Do not turn correlation into causation or add a dramatic percentage. Keep text readable on a phone. Variables: approved finding, dataset and citation; chart correctness needs human review. ``` ## SOC-04 — Cooking comparison thumbnail ```text Create a 16:9 video thumbnail comparing three ways of cutting a pear for serving: slices, cubes and a fan. Place three identical white plates in a row on a cobalt table, with matching pear color and consistent overhead light. Render only "One pear, three cuts" above them. Keep the cuts visually distinct and portions plausible. No nutrition claims, fake ratings, knives near hands or additional text. Variables: fruit and approved headline. ``` ## SOC-05 — Desk reset short-video cover ```text Create a 9:16 cover showing a half-tidy desk: papers aligned on the left, a closed notebook and cup on the right. Use natural overhead photography, soft shadows and a restrained sand-and-blue palette. Render "Reset your desk" in the central safe area and "Start with one surface" beneath. Keep important text away from the bottom quarter and right edge for platform overlays. No timer claim, app logos or extra copy. Variables: desk items and two-line title. ``` ## SOC-06 — Two-guest live announcement ```text Use two authorized adult portraits to create a 3:4 livestream announcement. Give each guest equal visual space, matching crop scale and neutral lighting; place names directly below their corresponding portraits. Render only [EVENT TITLE], [GUEST NAMES], [DATE] and [TIME ZONE]. Use a simple navy-and-cream grid without fake live indicators or platform logos. Preserve identities and do not invent credentials or attendance figures. Variables: two references and approved event copy. ``` ## SOC-07 — Verified quotation card ```text Create a square quotation card using [EXACT VERIFIED QUOTE] and [AUTHOR ATTRIBUTION]. Set the quote in large readable serif type on warm off-white paper; place attribution below, aligned to the same left edge. Add one small abstract blue line drawing in the lower corner. Preserve punctuation and wording exactly; do not shorten, fabricate or assign a quote to a different person. No portrait, signature or endorsement badge. Variables: verified quote, attribution and palette. ``` ## SOC-08 — Nine-step craft grid ```text Create a square three-by-three grid illustrating [NINE APPROVED CRAFT STEPS]. Use the same tabletop, hands and materials throughout, with clear progression from raw material to finished object. Label panels only "1" through "9", in left-to-right, top-to-bottom order. Keep tools and object proportions stable, and do not invent a step or show unsafe tool handling. No decorative words or duplicate panels. Variables: verified steps and materials; instructional accuracy requires review. ``` ## SOC-09 — Event recap mosaic ```text Create a 3:4 editorial recap layout for a fictional community drawing day. Arrange four image panels: sketchbooks on a table, hands drawing, a wall of unsigned sketches and empty stools at closing. Use consistent daylight and a small top heading "A day of drawing". Keep faces unidentifiable and artwork original. Do not add attendance numbers, sponsor marks or testimonial quotes. Leave a calm footer strip blank. Variables: activity and exact heading. ``` ## SOC-10 — Vertical cover crop study ```text Create a 9:16 creator-cover concept with a single red paper kite centered against a pale sky. Place "Build a paper kite" in the middle third, leaving the top fifteen percent and bottom twenty-five percent free of text. Keep the kite and headline legible within a central square crop as well. Use clean illustrative texture and a gently curved string. No platform UI, extra kites, fake buttons or small captions. Variables: object color and approved title. ``` [Back to the prompt index](./README.md).
description_en: Ten Qwen Image 3.0 recipes for social covers, thumbnails, quote cards and multi-panel grids, each specifying the exact copy to render, safe text zones and crop behaviour.
description_zh: 十条面向 Qwen Image 3.0 的社交媒体配方，涵盖封面、缩略图、引用卡与多格拼图，每条都写明需原样渲染的文案、文字安全区与裁切表现。
long_en: The recipes treat text as a hard constraint: every quoted string is rendered exactly once, never translated or paraphrased, and each layout reserves specific margins (a 9:16 cover keeps the top fifteen and bottom twenty-five percent clear of text; a 3:1 triptych master forbids any essential object or letter from crossing a crop boundary). Several add editorial guardrails — a research card must not overstate a finding, a growing-guide cover may not promise yields, and no layout may fake platform UI or buttons. Bracketed variables mark what the user replaces.
long_zh: 这组配方把文字当作硬性约束：所有引号内的文案必须原样渲染且只渲染一次，不得翻译或改写；每种版式都预留了具体留白（9:16 封面要求顶部 15%、底部 25% 不放文字；3:1 三联主图禁止任何关键物件或字母跨越裁切边界）。部分配方还加入了编辑层面的护栏——研究卡片不得夸大结论、种植指南封面不得承诺产量、任何版式都不得伪造平台 UI 与按钮。方括号变量标出用户需要替换的部分。
sec_note_en: Plain text prompts; no tool access or external calls. Several recipes render claims, quotations or statistics into an image — verify the source and attribution yourself, since the prompt only instructs the model not to invent numbers and cannot guarantee it. Written for Qwen Image 3.0; the source repo is maintained by the commercial platform bestimage.ai, though these prompt files contain no product placement.
sec_note_zh: 纯文本提示词，不涉及工具调用或外部请求。部分配方会把观点、引语或统计数字渲染进图片——请自行核实来源与署名，因为提示词只是要求模型不要编造数字，并不能保证做到。针对 Qwen Image 3.0 撰写；来源仓库由商业平台 bestimage.ai 维护，但这些提示词文件本身没有产品植入。
